profile.headline: Software Engineer Intern @ ASRC Federal | U.S. Navy Veteran | Rowan 2026
profile.summary:
I am a Computing and Informatics student (minor in Computer Science) at Rowan University and a Software Engineer Intern working with ASRC Federal Mission Solutions, where I focus on modernizing naval user interfaces, prototyping in C++ and Qt and now rebuilding in React.

Before transitioning into software engineering, I served in the U.S. Navy as a Cryptologic Technician Technical (E-5), leading a team of 20 sailors while maintaining electronic warfare and anti-ship missile defense systems.

I enjoy participating in hackathons and game development competitions, where I collaborate under tight deadlines, from 24-hour hackathons to 30-day game jams, to design and build applications, games, and websites. I am graduating in Fall 2026 and seeking full-time software engineering roles.

Tools & Platforms: Linux/Unix, Git, GitHub, Visual Studio, Godot, React, Qt, Redis/Valkey
Programming Languages: Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, SQL, Bash, GDScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
ASRC Federal Mission Solutions – Moorestown, NJ 
- Prototype a new Aegis Combat System user interface to improve usability and support modern naval systems. 
- Overhaul a Qt C++ desktop application to replace SQLite backend with Redis/Valkey and Oat++ WebSockets, decoupling the UI from the data layer.

positions.title: Student Tech Lead at Rowan University
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
-Managing equipment (e.g., Computers, 3D printer, Raspberry Pi, robotic arm).
-Creating guides for equipment use.
-Overseeing student workers.
-Gathering feedback through questionnaires to improve the space.

positions.title: Cryptologic Technician (Technical) - U.S. Navy
positions.description:
Rank: E-5
-Specialized in electronic warfare, radar surveillance, and missile defense.
-Led a team of 22 personnel as a Work Center Supervisor, ensuring mission-critical systems were maintained and operational.
-Developed skills in problem-solving, analysis, and leadership.

honors.title: Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal (2x)
honors.description: Awarded two Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medals for exemplary performance as a Cryptologic Technician and Work Center Supervisor onboard USS Leyte Gulf (CG-55).

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Earned the rank of Eagle Scout, demonstrating leadership, commitment, and community service.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 2019

projects.title: NutriPlan
projects.description: Co-developed a full-stack recipe web app with user accounts, recipe search, and saved favorites. Built with JavaScript, Bootstrap, Node.js/Express, SQLite, and the Spoonacular API.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: Designed and developed a responsive portfolio website showcasing my experience, projects, and resume: jaymesmorris.com
